# QRo QR Code Generator

> Open-source, client-side, customizable QR code generator creating static QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi networks, and contact cards (vCards).

## Overview
- [QRo Web Application](https://qro.anwincm.dev/): Client-side interactive QR code generator with real-time preview and custom styling.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Imperfect-spiker28/QR): Official open-source repository licensed under the MIT License.
- [Creator Profile](https://anwincm.dev/): Anwin C M, creator and maintainer of QRo.
- [XML Sitemap](https://qro.anwincm.dev/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all indexable canonical URLs.
- [Robots Directives](https://qro.anwincm.dev/robots.txt): Crawler indexing and agent retrieval directives.
- [AI Catalog Manifest](https://qro.anwincm.dev/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable Agent Resource Discovery (ARD) capability manifest.

## Primary Pages & Capabilities
- [Interactive QR Generator](https://qro.anwincm.dev/): Full-featured browser-based creator for URLs, plain text, Wi-Fi credentials, and contact cards (vCards).
- [Curated QR Templates](https://qro.anwincm.dev/templates): Directory of aesthetic presets including Tiffany Noir, Sunset Glow, Cyberpunk Blue, and Classic Monochrome.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://qro.anwincm.dev/faq): Comprehensive knowledge base answering 9 core questions on QR generation, error correction, offline generation, and print formats.
- [Engineering & Design Guides](https://qro.anwincm.dev/guides): Technical guides covering scannability rules, optical contrast, print standards, and privacy architecture.

## Technical Guides
- [Vector SVG vs Raster PNG](https://qro.anwincm.dev/guides/svg-vs-png): Technical comparison of infinite vector scalability vs bitmap resolution for commercial print and digital sharing.
- [QR Code Contrast & Scannability](https://qro.anwincm.dev/guides/qr-contrast-ratio): Detailed explanation of optical camera sensor binarization, the 4:1 luminance contrast rule, and quiet zone requirements.
- [Logo Embedding & Reed-Solomon Error Correction](https://qro.anwincm.dev/guides/logo-error-correction): How Reed-Solomon Level H mathematics allow safe center emblem embedding with a 30% area ceiling.
- [Static vs Dynamic QR Codes](https://qro.anwincm.dev/guides/static-vs-dynamic): Architectural comparison showing why direct matrix encoding eliminates subscription paywalls and redirect outage risks.

## Key Capabilities & Supported Content Types
1. **Website Links (URLs)**: Direct encoding of destination URLs. No intermediary redirect servers, tracking URLs, or forced domain proxies.
2. **Plain Text**: Raw text messages, snippets, codes, or instructions.
3. **Wi-Fi Credentials**: Seamless network connection QR codes supporting WPA/WPA2/WPA3, WEP, and unencrypted open networks.
4. **Contact Cards (vCards)**: Direct vCard 3.0 encoding with Name, Phone, Email, Organization, and Website fields.

## Aesthetic Customization & Scannability
- **Pattern Styles**: Classic square matrix, smooth rounded dots, and modern dot matrix.
- **Color Customization**: Custom foreground and background colors with real-time WCAG contrast safety evaluation.
- **Gradients**: Dual-tone linear gradients (radial/linear transitions).
- **Logo Embedding**: Center logo embedding with automatic error-correction level adjustment (Reed-Solomon Level H/Q) and smart safe area masking under 30% canvas area to preserve scan integrity.
- **Default Logo**: Includes official Anwin brand emblem by default, fully replaceable with user-uploaded PNG, JPG, or SVG logos.
- **Frames & Captions**: Customizable frames with "SCAN TO OPEN" (or custom text), custom caption colors, and 100+ Google Fonts.

## Export Formats
- **Raster PNG**: Ultra-high-resolution downloads (512px, 1024px, up to 2048px).
- **Vector SVG**: Infinitely scalable vector graphics ideal for packaging, signage, billboards, and merchandise.
- **Standard JPG**: Compact photographic format for quick digital sharing.

## Privacy & Security Guarantees
- **Zero Server Storage**: QR code generation and image rendering take place entirely inside the user's browser runtime.
- **No Tracking Middleman**: Destination links are encoded directly without redirect URLs or subscription expirations.
- **Zero Account Requirement**: No signups, accounts, paywalls, subscriptions, or hidden advertising.
- **Privacy-Conscious Analytics**: Telemetry (if enabled) excludes all user-generated payloads, URLs, passwords, and contact information.
